accepted.s: Which one of the following tribes is associated with the Nallamala forests around Srisailam and is recognised as a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group?
accepted.x: The Chenchus inhabit the Nallamala forests around Srisailam and are a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG).
accepted.tq: Use the tribe–habitat association to identify the correct option.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Koya tribe of Andhra Pradesh is primarily associated with which of the following regions?
o: Southern coastal plains near Pulicat Lake
accepted.x: The Koyas are concentrated in the Godavari valley agency, including the Chintoor and Polavaram areas, and call themselves Koyi Toor.
accepted.tq: Test the direct tribe–region pair and distinguish neighbouring tribal habitats.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. Savara and Jatapu — North coastal hills
b. Gadaba and Bagata — Araku Valley and ASR agency
c. Yanadi — Southern plains near Pulicat Lake
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All three pairs are correctly matched. Savara and Jatapu occur in the north coastal hills, Gadaba and Bagata in the Araku–ASR region, and Yanadi in the southern and coastal plains near Pulicat Lake.
accepted.tq: Verify each tribe–habitat pair before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: Koya — north coastal hills of Srikakulam
accepted.x: The Yerukula live mainly in the plains and are traditionally associated with fortune-telling. Sugalis or Lambadas are associated with Rayalaseema and thandas, while Yanadis occur in the coastal and southern plains and Koyas in the Godavari agency.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive occupational and habitat association.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Yerukula are known by which corresponding names in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka respectively?
accepted.x: The Yerukula are known as Korava in Tamil Nadu and Korcha in Karnataka.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related regional names of the same community.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following tribes is associated with podu cultivation in the hill tracts of East and West Godavari and is also a PVTG?
accepted.x: The Konda Reddis inhabit the hill tracts of East and West Godavari, particularly the Rampa region, practise podu cultivation and are classified as a PVTG.
accepted.tq: Match the tribe with its distinctive livelihood and geographical setting.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Konda Doras served as which of the following in the Rampa agency?
accepted.x: The Konda Doras served as Mutadars, or hill chiefs, of the Rampa agency.
accepted.tq: Identify the traditional administrative role associated with the community.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT associated with the Araku Valley or ASR agency?
accepted.x: Gadaba, Kotia and Porja are associated with the Araku Valley and ASR agency. Yanadi are mainly associated with the southern and coastal plains, including the area near Pulicat Lake.
accepted.tq: Find the tribe belonging to a contrasting habitat rather than the agency region.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Chenchus are described in relation to Andhra Pradesh as which of the following?
o: The earliest urban tribe of the coast
The aboriginal tribe of Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The Chenchus are described as the “aboriginal tribe” of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Recognise the exact descriptive title attached to the tribe.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following groups consists entirely of tribes that are not tribes of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Munda, Santhal and Bhil are identified as tribes from other states and not as major tribes of Andhra Pradesh in this context.
accepted.tq: Eliminate the options containing established Andhra Pradesh tribal groups.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Chenchus recorded in the Nallamala ranges of Andhra Pradesh by ITDA records numbered approximately:
accepted.x: ITDA records counted 47,315 Chenchus in the Nallamala ranges of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Recall the specific population figure and distinguish it from broader SC/ST totals.
accepted.sec: Major tribes of AP → district/habitat, and odd-one-out tribes from other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The SC and ST Orders (Amendment) Act, 1976 notified how many Scheduled Tribes in undivided Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The 1976 Amendment Act notified 33 Scheduled Tribes in undivided Andhra Pradesh. The present APSES figure for AP is 34 ST communities, while some older material mentions 35.
accepted.tq: Separate the historical amendment figure from present and alternative counts.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following sets contains the five Scheduled Tribes that had area restrictions under the 1976 amendment?
o: Gowdu, Mali, Nayak, Thoti and Valmiki
Chenchu, Koya, Yanadi, Savara and Jatapu
Munda, Santhal, Bhil, Konda Dora and Porja
Gadaba, Bagata, Kotia, Khond and Sugali
accepted.x: The five tribes with area restrictions were Gowdu, Mali, Nayak, Thoti and Valmiki. Gowdu, Nayak and Valmiki were restricted to the Agency tracts.
accepted.tq: Use the complete five-member list and check the special restriction within it.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to APSES 2024–25, the present number of Scheduled Tribe communities in Andhra Pradesh is:
accepted.x: APSES 2024–25 records 34 Scheduled Tribe communities in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current administrative figure from the historical amendment count.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to Census 2011 figures used for Andhra Pradesh, which of the following correctly represents the Scheduled Caste population and share?
accepted.x: The Scheduled Caste population was 84.69 lakh, constituting 17.08% of the population of the 13-district Andhra Pradesh of 2011.
accepted.tq: Split the options by both population figure and percentage rather than relying on one value.
accepted.sec: SC and ST share of AP population - Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the Scheduled Tribe population and share of Andhra Pradesh according to Census 2011 figures used by APSES?
accepted.x: The Scheduled Tribe population was 27.39 lakh, constituting 5.53% of Andhra Pradesh’s population. The figures 26.31 lakh and 5.3% occur in older material but are not the APSES figures used here.
accepted.tq: Use the paired population-and-share figure and reject the older alternative.
accepted.sec: SC and ST share of AP population - Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In India, Scheduled Tribes constituted what percentage of the population, and what percentage of them were rural, according to the stated figures?
accepted.x: Scheduled Tribes constituted 8.6% of India’s population, and 89.97% of the Scheduled Tribe population was rural.
accepted.tq: Keep the national figures separate from the corresponding Andhra Pradesh figures.
accepted.sec: SC and ST share of AP population - Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The approximate Scheduled Tribe population of Visakhapatnam district in Census 2011 was:
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam district had approximately 6.18 lakh Scheduled Tribe persons in Census 2011.
accepted.tq: Recall the district-specific number and distinguish it from state-level totals.
accepted.sec: Districts with highest SC and ST population/share  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following districts in descending order of Scheduled Caste share as indicated by the stated district figures:
A. Visakhapatnam
B. Nellore
C. Prakasam
accepted.x: Prakasam had the highest SC share at 23.19%, followed by Nellore at 22.49%, while Visakhapatnam had the lowest among these at 7.68%.
accepted.tq: Order the districts by comparing the numerical percentages, not by geographical location.
accepted.sec: Districts with highest SC and ST population/share  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which district had the lowest Scheduled Caste share among the district figures stated for Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam had the lowest stated SC share at 7.68%, compared with 23.19% in Prakasam and 22.49% in Nellore.
accepted.tq: Use the extreme-value comparison to identify the lowest share.
accepted.sec: Districts with highest SC and ST population/share  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct descending order of the stated Scheduled Caste shares?
accepted.x: The stated SC shares are Prakasam 23.19%, Nellore 22.49% and Visakhapatnam 7.68%, giving the order Prakasam, Nellore and Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Compare close percentages carefully before arranging the districts.
accepted.sec: Districts with highest SC and ST population/share  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the ST literacy rate and ST sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The stated ST literacy rate is 48.8% and the ST sex ratio is 1009.
accepted.tq: Match the two indicators in the correct order and avoid substituting the population share.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Parvathipuram Manyam, Vizianagaram, ASR, Anakapalli and Eluru
Prakasam, Nellore, Kurnool, Kadapa and Chittoor
Visakhapatnam, Guntur, Krishna, Anantapur and Tirupati
Srikakulam, Kakinada, Bapatla, Nandyal and Sri Sathya Sai
accepted.x: The stated Scheduled-area districts are Parvathipuram Manyam, Vizianagaram, Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli and Eluru.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete district list and reject lists from other regions.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh cover approximately how much area and how many villages?
accepted.x: The Scheduled Areas cover 16,267.63 square kilometres, or 10.15% of the area, and include 3,512 villages.
accepted.tq: Select the option that preserves both the area and village count.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Approximately how many Scheduled Tribes live inside the Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Approximately 12.9 lakh Scheduled Tribe persons live inside the Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Scheduled-Area population from the total ST population of the State.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the recent administrative changes affecting tribal areas is correct?
o: Polavaram district was carved from ASR on 31 December 2025 and has Rampachodavaram as its headquarters.
ASR district was carved from Polavaram on 31 December 2025 and has Chintoor as its headquarters.
Rampachodavaram district was carved from ASR on 31 December 2025 and has Polavaram as its headquarters.
Polavaram district was carved from Visakhapatnam on 31 December 2025 and has Eluru as its headquarters.
accepted.x: Polavaram district was carved from Alluri Sitharama Raju district on 31 December 2025, with headquarters at Rampachodavaram. It holds the Rampachodavaram and Chintoor ITDAs.
accepted.tq: Track the direction of administrative reorganisation and match the headquarters precisely.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly identifies the two ITDAs held by Polavaram district?
accepted.x: Polavaram district holds the Rampachodavaram and Chintoor Integrated Tribal Development Agencies.
accepted.tq: Use the district–ITDA administrative association.
accepted.sec: Number of notified Scheduled Tribes in AP - ST Orders amendments  [APPSC]
